verdict.rationale: Running a compliance platform's automation from CI or a headless pipeline (via a CLI or API token) is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows an MCP server that lets an AI assistant work inside the workspace, plus native integrations and monitors that collect data automatically. None of that documents running Thoropass headlessly or in CI: there is no CLI, no CI pipeline integration and no non-interactive API-token workflow. The MCP server belongs to a separate story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
